source.conversion: T = 87 − 3.2 × (E_best − E) / 100, E the nation's Elo on 1990-07-09 (the day after the final) and E_best the best of the teams active in the four years before (Germany, 1924); the XI (1 GK, 4 DF, 4 MF, 2 FW, the most minutes) ordered by Ballon d'Or points, World Cup awards, goals a minute and minutes; its k-th player T + D_k, D = +5.3, +3.3, +2.1, +1.0, 0.0, −0.4, −1.0, −1.7, −2.1, −2.7, −3.9, rounded so the XI sums to round(11 × T)
